questions.question: Which country hosted the COP28 climate summit in late 2023, with global climate policy discussions continuing into 2025–2026?
questions.explanation: COP28 was hosted in Dubai, UAE, where global leaders discussed fossil fuel transition and climate financing.

questions.question: Which company became the world's most valuable semiconductor manufacturer during the AI chip boom?
questions.explanation: NVIDIA surged in valuation due to massive demand for GPUs used in AI model training.

questions.question: Which conflict region has seen continued ceasefire negotiations mediated by multiple countries in recent global diplomacy efforts?
questions.explanation: The Israel–Gaza conflict has remained a major international diplomatic focus.

questions.question: Which organization regulates global monetary cooperation and frequently publishes global growth forecasts?
questions.explanation: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) publishes global economic outlook reports.

questions.question: Which space agency launched the Artemis program to return humans to the Moon?
questions.explanation: NASA’s Artemis program aims to establish long-term human presence on the Moon.

questions.question: Which technology trend has driven massive investment in data centers worldwide?
questions.explanation: AI infrastructure demand has accelerated global data-center construction.

questions.question: Which country recently became the most populous nation in the world?
questions.explanation: India surpassed China in population according to UN estimates.

questions.question: Which global sporting event is scheduled to be hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico?
questions.explanation: The FIFA World Cup 2026 will be jointly hosted by the U.S., Canada, and Mexico.

questions.question: Which central bank controls monetary policy in the United States?
questions.explanation: The Federal Reserve sets interest rates and manages U.S. monetary policy.

questions.question: Which renewable energy source has seen the fastest global installation growth recently?
questions.explanation: Solar energy installations have grown rapidly due to falling costs and policy incentives.

questions.question: Which country successfully landed the Chandrayaan-3 mission near the Moon’s south pole?
questions.explanation: India became the first country to land near the lunar south pole with Chandrayaan-3.

questions.question: Which organization governs international football competitions?
questions.explanation: FIFA organizes the Football World Cup and oversees global football governance.

questions.question: Which global tech company is known for developing the GPT series of AI models?
questions.explanation: OpenAI developed the GPT family of large language models.

questions.question: Which country is the largest producer of crude oil globally?
questions.explanation: The United States has led global oil production in recent years.

questions.question: Which organization conducts global public-health emergency coordination?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization coordinates global health responses.

questions.question: Which country hosted the G20 Summit in 2023, influencing ongoing global economic discussions?
questions.explanation: India hosted the G20 Summit in New Delhi.

questions.question: Which electric-vehicle company has remained a global market leader in EV sales?
questions.explanation: Tesla continues to be a major leader in global EV adoption.

questions.question: Which currency is used across most European Union countries?
questions.explanation: The euro is the common currency of the Eurozone.

questions.question: Which organization regulates international trade rules?
questions.explanation: The World Trade Organization sets rules for global trade.

questions.question: Which technology sector has driven stock-market growth due to AI infrastructure demand?
questions.explanation: Semiconductor companies have surged due to AI computing demand.
